*"What is old can be used for parts!"*

__Overview__

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Generates military-themed junk.

| **Item Name** | **Drop Rate** | 
| Dog Tags | 28.20% | 
| Military Ammo Bag | 4.00% | 
| Military Grade Duct Tape | 24.20% | 
| Military-Grade Circuit Board | 15.40% | 
| Unrefined Gunpowder | 28.20% | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 2

__Crafting Requirements__

- 4x Circuitry
- 2x Glass
- 6x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 6 pounds of military-themed junk

## **__How to Unlock__**

__How to Unlock__

- Seasonal Reward: Season 23 – Page 10 – 40 Tickets
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Guides:

- N/A

__Build Restrictions__

- Shares Build Limit With: None
- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
